notes: Flaw IDs are the contract between busk's form analysis and this benchmark. Patterns are case-insensitive Python regexes matched against each feedback line. fix_patterns credit actionable advice for a flaw; mention_patterns only identify the flaw and are used for detection when the analyzer reports no flaw IDs. label_rule documents the kinematic threshold the synthetic clips use to decide the ground-truth label. coaching_priority is the order a coach fixes flaws in (1 first: where the ball starts and that it moves in one motion; 2 the base; 3 the release; 4 the finish). label_rule.bad is where a flaw turns from marginal (past value, short of bad) to clearly bad; held-out flaws are drawn past it. A clip's primary flaw is its clearly bad flaw with the lowest coaching_priority, so a marginal flaw never outranks a clearly bad one whatever its rank; how far past the threshold a flaw is only breaks ties within a rank.

flaws.name: No leg drive
flaws.description: Shooter barely bends the knees and powers the ball with the arms.
flaws.canonical_fix: Bend your knees and drive up through your legs; the power should come from the floor, not your arms.

flaws.name: Low set point
flaws.description: The ball is pushed from the chest or chin instead of from a set point at or above the forehead.
flaws.canonical_fix: Bring the ball up to a set point above your forehead before releasing; don't push it from your chest.

flaws.name: Elbow flare
flaws.description: The shooting elbow sticks out to the side instead of staying under the ball, pushing the shot off line.
flaws.canonical_fix: Tuck your shooting elbow under the ball so your elbow, wrist and the rim line up.

flaws.name: Flat arc
flaws.description: The ball leaves on a flat trajectory (launch angle well under 45 degrees), shrinking the target at the rim.
flaws.canonical_fix: Put more arc on it; shoot up and over the front of the rim (around 45-50 degrees), not straight at it.

flaws.name: No follow-through
flaws.description: The shooting arm drops immediately after release with no wrist snap or held finish.
flaws.canonical_fix: Snap your wrist and hold your follow-through, fingers pointing at the rim, until the ball lands.

flaws.name: Guide hand interference
flaws.description: The non-shooting hand pushes or flicks the ball at release, adding side spin and pushing it off line.
flaws.canonical_fix: Keep your guide hand on the side of the ball and let it come off cleanly; only the shooting hand pushes.
fix_patterns: \b(guide|off|non[- ]?shooting|support|balance|other|left|right)[- ]?hand\b.{0,40}\b(off|still|quiet|on the side|side|away|out of|only guides?|just guides?|come off|comes off|relax\w*|no push|not push|don'?t push)\b

flaws.name: Releasing on the way down
flaws.description: The ball is released well after the peak of the jump, so leg power is lost and the shot is short.
flaws.canonical_fix: Release at the top of your jump or on the way up; you are letting go on the way down and losing your legs.
mention_patterns: \b(on the way down|while (you'?re )?falling|after the (peak|top)|late release|releas\w* late)\b
fix_patterns: \b(release|let (it|the ball) go|get (it|the shot|the ball) off|shoot)\b.{0,40}\b(earlier|sooner|at the top|at the peak|at the apex|on the way up|before (you )?(land|come down|start falling|drop))\b
\b(don'?t|stop|avoid|no)\b.{0,20}\b(wait\w*|hang\w*|shoot\w* on the way down|releas\w* on the way down)\b

flaws.name: Hitch at the set point
flaws.description: The ball stops at the set point (two-motion pause), killing rhythm and slowing the release.
flaws.canonical_fix: Make it one smooth motion from the dip to the release; don't stop the ball at your set point.

flaws.name: Off-balance drift
flaws.description: The shooter fades, leans or drifts in the air and lands well away from the takeoff spot.
flaws.canonical_fix: Jump straight up and land where you took off; drifting in the air throws off your aim and distance.
